Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.True aristocrats enjoy two things above all else: collecting beautiful works of art and ritual sacrifice in the pursuit of absolute power—and with this drop, they don’t have to choose. Cunningly crafted following the ancient rites of linocut printmaking, Kathleen Neeley’s playfully sinister art begs you to sacrifice everything except your sense of taste.
Art by Kathleen Neeley
Contents:
• 1x Rainbow Foil Dictate of Erebos
• 1x Rainbow Foil Fecundity
• 1x Rainbow Foil Mayhem Devil
• 1x Rainbow Foil Moldervine Reclamation
• 1x Rainbow Foil Prossh, Skyraider of Kher
